derivation: min_passed is the number of cases each suite reported on the Phase 9 release run recorded in PROGRESS.md, except skills, which was re-measured at 81 after adding the setup-agentos built-in (knowledge 10, ddd 6, context 14, skills 81, feedback 41, architecture 2, workflow 21, memory 10, adapters 12). Context max_observed_tokens is the largest max_tokens already stored on an evals/context case (ambiguous_service_012.json, 1577). max_irrelevant_ratio is 0 because every Phase 4 context case measured 0 irrelevant tokens. No number in this file was chosen as a target before that measurement. A later suite that passes fewer cases than min_passed, or a context pack larger than 1577 tokens, fails the dashboard.
